targets.name: Tests.OnlineFTLLimitSemantics.alternating_unit
targets.header:
theorem alternating_unit :
    (∀ t, alternatingObservation t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
    alternatingObservation 0 = 0 ∧ alternatingObservation 1 = 1

targets.name: Tests.OnlineFTLLimitSemantics.alternating_prefix_sum
targets.header:
theorem alternating_prefix_sum (T : ℕ) :
    (∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, alternatingObservation t) = ((T / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)

targets.name: Tests.OnlineFTLLimitSemantics.alternating_mean_tendsto
targets.header:
theorem alternating_mean_tendsto :
    Tendsto (empiricalMean alternatingObservation) atTop (nhds ((1 : ℝ) / 2))

targets.name: Tests.OnlineFTLLimitSemantics.alternating_initial_predictions
targets.header:
theorem alternating_initial_predictions :
    meanPredict alternatingObservation 0 = (1 : ℝ) / 2 ∧
    meanPredict alternatingObservation 1 = 0 ∧
    meanPredict alternatingObservation 2 = (1 : ℝ) / 2 ∧
    meanPredict alternatingObservation 3 = (1 : ℝ) / 3

targets.name: Tests.OnlineFTLLimitSemantics.alternating_best_regret_zero_one_two
targets.header:
theorem alternating_best_regret_zero_one_two :
    squaredBestRegret alternatingObservation (meanPredict alternatingObservation) 0 = 0 ∧
    squaredBestRegret alternatingObservation (meanPredict alternatingObservation) 1 = (1 : ℝ) / 4 ∧
    squaredBestRegret alternatingObservation (meanPredict alternatingObservation) 2 = (3 : ℝ) / 4

targets.name: Tests.OnlineFTLLimitSemantics.alternating_actual_gap_nonneg
targets.header:
theorem alternating_actual_gap_nonneg (T : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ comparatorRegret (fun t x => (x - alternatingObservation t)^2)
      (meanPredict alternatingObservation) (empiricalMean alternatingObservation T) T

targets.name: Tests.OnlineFTLLimitSemantics.alternating_fixed_decomposition
targets.header:
theorem alternating_fixed_decomposition (u : ℝ) (T : ℕ) :
    comparatorRegret (fun t x => (x - alternatingObservation t)^2)
      (meanPredict alternatingObservation) u T =
    comparatorRegret (fun t x => (x - alternatingObservation t)^2)
      (meanPredict alternatingObservation) (empiricalMean alternatingObservation T) T -
      (T : ℝ) * (u - empiricalMean alternatingObservation T)^2

targets.name: Tests.OnlineFTLLimitSemantics.alternating_best_average_zero
targets.header:
theorem alternating_best_average_zero :
    Tendsto (fun T : ℕ =>
      squaredBestRegret alternatingObservation (meanPredict alternatingObservation) T / (T : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds (0 : ℝ))

targets.name: Tests.OnlineFTLLimitSemantics.alternating_fixed_limit_criterion
targets.header:
theorem alternating_fixed_limit_criterion (u a : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun T : ℕ => comparatorRegret
      (fun t x => (x - alternatingObservation t)^2)
      (meanPredict alternatingObservation) u T / (T : ℝ)) atTop (nhds a) ↔
    Tendsto (fun T : ℕ => (u - empiricalMean alternatingObservation T)^2)
      atTop (nhds (-a))

targets.name: Tests.OnlineFTLLimitSemantics.alternating_fixed_zero_negative_limit
targets.header:
theorem alternating_fixed_zero_negative_limit :
    Tendsto (fun T : ℕ => comparatorRegret
      (fun t x => (x - alternatingObservation t)^2)
      (meanPredict alternatingObservation) 0 T / (T : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds (-(1 : ℝ) / 4))

targets.name: Tests.OnlineFTLLimitSemantics.alternating_fixed_half_zero_limit
targets.header:
theorem alternating_fixed_half_zero_limit :
    Tendsto (fun T : ℕ => comparatorRegret
      (fun t x => (x - alternatingObservation t)^2)
      (meanPredict alternatingObservation) ((1 : ℝ) / 2) T / (T : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds (0 : ℝ))

targets.name: Tests.OnlineFTLLimitSemantics.alternating_literal_limit_noRegret
targets.header:
theorem alternating_literal_limit_noRegret :
    LimitNoRegret (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
      (fun t x => (x - alternatingObservation t)^2) (meanPredict alternatingObservation)
